what: IQ3_S decode campaign window A: EXPDEC gate/up kernel matrix + bitwise parity, decode attribution, routing trace, and the down-arm kernel finding

window.parity: 6/6 PASS: iq_parity, iq_multi_parity, s2_expert_grouped_parity, default AND under STRATA_EXPDEC=1

attribution.conclusion: decode is GPU-bound: 66% of the round is the host waiting on the GPU; the grouped experts are ~15% of the round (5.2 of 35.4 ms) and run at ~690 GB/s (HBM-bound)

routing_trace.implication: the real verify-window envelope is G ~= 34, T ~= 1, not the denser G20 T4 used by the first bench pass

kernel_matrix_gate_up.shape: layers 0,1,2,8,12,17,21,47 = the 7 real format pairs; gu sums over 8 layers, two runs each; 0 differing in every cell
kernel_matrix_gate_up.decision: K1 REJECTED: EXPDEC gate/up is 3-8% slower at the grouped shape and a tie at single-token; a slower kernel cannot clear the +2% e2e gate

down_finding.shape: G34 T1 (real envelope), per-layer down time, first run of each process
down_finding.expected_e2e: ~11 us/layer saved x 48 layers = 0.53 ms/round of 35.4 ms = ~1.5% (below the 2% gate; e2e decides in window B)
down_finding.decision: K2 CANDIDATE: bitwise-correct (same parity suite) and faster on every down format; e2e gate in window B

deviations: expdec_bench is CUDA-only in CMakeLists (EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL under STRATA_ENABLE_CUDA); the matrix ran through native_expert_bench + the parity ctests instead
the one-shot path does not print the STRATA_DECODE_TIMING / STRATA_VERIFY_PROFILE stage line (docs: serve path) - window B runs the serve path
window A's e2e block was skipped after EXPDEC lost the kernel bench; baseline cells deferred to window B
not_done: the down arm e2e - window B
